observation: Beat-edit guides this month teach cutting in bar-sized blocks: a new shot on each downbeat, often every 4 beats, with motion kept inside the shot between cuts (cursa.app's CapCut beat-editing chapter; CapCut's montage-rhythm and sports beat-sync guides; Hollyland's Premiere beat-edit workflow). Making today's Short, every shot length had to be written as a beat count (beats:2, beats:6), and phrasing the edit in bars meant doing the 4x arithmetic by hand for each shot.
suggestion: Accept "duration": "bars:N" in reel shots (and stagger) as N bars of the beat grid, 4 beats per bar by default with an optional audio.beats_per_bar, resolved exactly like beats:N so snapping and the beat audit work unchanged; validate it, document it in docs/reel.md next to beats:N.
would_enable: A how-to Short that phrases a whole edit in bars ("one shot per bar") with the beat audit showing each cut on the grid.
